annotations.title: Check a 402 quote against what you expected before you sign it (paid, x402)

description: PAID: grade an x402 challenge you are about to sign against what you expected -- payee, resource, network, asset and price -- and get back a verdict, score and reasons in the same response the payment settles. Pass the accepts[] entry you already hold: we never re-fetch the seller, because a second fetch would grade a different response than the one you are about to pay for. A missing or hostile field inside the quote is a FINDING in the answer, never a refusal. Call it once without payment to receive the price as an x402 PaymentRequired (Base USDC, and Solana USDC where offered); call it again with a signed payment in _meta['x402/payment'] to complete it. The receipt comes back in _meta['x402/payment-response']. No account, no API key. Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST /feedback on this host -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

claim.description: What you believed before you asked: the URL you requested, and optionally the payee, network, asset and ceiling you agreed to.

quote.description: One accepts[] entry out of the 402 you received, verbatim. Every field optional: an absent one is a finding.
